Initializes and deletes an lthash adder, with alignment checks and SIMD batch pointer setup.

# Purpose
Initializes and clears an `fd_lthash_adder_t` object used for local hash addition. The [`fd_lthash_adder_new`](<#fd_lthash_adder_new>) function checks for a `NULL` pointer and for proper alignment with `FD_LTHASH_ADDER_ALIGN`, logs a warning on error, and then zeroes the full structure with `fd_memset`. When AVX or AVX-512 support is available, it also sets up `batch_ptrs` entries to point into `batch_data` in chunk-sized steps based on `FD_LTHASH_ADDER_PARA_CNT`. The [`fd_lthash_adder_delete`](<#fd_lthash_adder_delete>) function does not release any resource and returns `NULL`, which indicates that the object has no separate destruction work.
